title: Coral and the Compass
author: Theo Voss
blurb: Tamsin Winterbourne, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the dry season ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
